founder.title: Why Protocol?
founder.p1: In fifteen years as a PT I kept seeing the same thing: plans thrown together in a hurry because programming with care takes too much work.
founder.p2: Protocol is here to take that excuse off the table. Human and scientific at the base — you decide, AI handles the repetitive drafting, and the manuals (ACSM, Bompa, NSCA) ground the choices. New evidence is added gradually, always with a verifiable source.
founder.p3: We don't want to automate coaching. We want "I didn't have time" to stop being the reason behind a weak plan — for PTs, and for people training on their own.
founder.signature: — André Periquito, MSc Exercise & Health · Exercise Physiologist & Personal Trainer

faq.title: Questions coaches and trainees ask us.
faq.q1_q: Is the AI plan good enough to send to clients as-is?
faq.q1_a: It's a solid starting point, not a destination. For now, AI is help — you are the filter. As we earn confidence in its outputs, we hand back more autonomy. Until then, edit volume, swap exercises, adapt the language; Protocol does the heavy lifting, you have the final word.
faq.q2_q: What if my client has injuries or medical conditions?
faq.q2_a: PAR-Q+ flags trigger conditional logic. Cardiac flags default the plan to low-intensity. Joint flags exclude high-impact patterns. You always have final approval before generation.
faq.q3_q: Can I use my own branding on the PDF?
faq.q3_a: Yes. Upload your logo and business name in Settings. Every PDF export is branded with your studio identity, not Protocol's.
faq.q4_q: What happens to my client data?
faq.q4_a: Stored in Supabase (EU region). You can export or delete any client record at any time. Protocol does not share or sell client data — ever.
faq.q5_q: What science is the programming based on?
faq.q5_a: Manuals already inside today: ACSM 12e, Bompa-Buzzichelli (6e), NSCA Essentials (3e). Anything added next will have a verifiable source (PubMed and equivalents) — nothing cited under an author's name without the actual book or paper being inside. You can (and should) verify.
faq.q6_q: What if the client regresses mid-block?
faq.q6_a: You re-run the assessment, the programming tier adjusts (e.g. advanced → conservative) and the next block regenerates with tighter constraints. The previous block stays archived for history.
faq.q7_q: Can I edit the generated plan before export?
faq.q7_a: Yes — at all 5 stages (Brief, Blueprint, Microcycle, Progressions, Sessions). Every edit is logged and the PDF only ships after your final approval.
faq.q8_q: Does it work offline or on the client's phone?
faq.q8_a: The PDF works offline on any device. The set logbook is web (tested on Mobile Safari at 375px) — just share the plan link, no app to install.
faq.q9_q: How many plans can I generate on the free tier?
faq.q9_a: 1 full plan per account. Enough to test the end-to-end flow with a real client. Paid tiers unlock 8 / 30 / 80 plans per month as you scale (client cap = plan cap, no fine print).
faq.q10_q: How do I know the AI didn't invent a dangerous exercise?
faq.q10_a: Every exercise is validated against the PROTOCOL library (movement pattern, equipment, contraindications). Nothing outside the library reaches the plan. PAR-Q+ flags apply hard exclusions before generation.
faq.q11_q: Do I need experience to use this?
faq.q11_a: No. The assessment walks you through, section by section, and the AI assembles the plan. Coaches get speed. Solo trainees get structure.
faq.q12_q: Can I use this without a coach?
faq.q12_a: Yes. Run the assessment as a trainee, generate your plan and follow it through the logbook. The AI gives weekly feedback based on what you log.
faq.q13_q: How is this different from ChatGPT or generic AI?
faq.q13_a: ChatGPT generates what you ask. Protocol runs 14 clinical sections (PAR-Q+, ACSM, mobility, history) before prescribing one exercise, with block periodization and a validated exercise library.
faq.q14_q: What happens when the trial ends?
faq.q14_a: The 7 days are enough to run the assessment, generate the plan, and start training safely. If you want to continue, activate the monthly plan and you keep ongoing generation, the logbook that learns with you, the community and what comes next. If not, you keep the PDF and the support videos — the app pauses until you return. It's a service, and we want it to be worth every cent.

progressionsGuide.title: How to read these deltas
items: W2/W3/W4 = the change applied that week vs Week 1.
"+1rep" = aim for one extra rep per set.
Empty = no change that week (hold or deload).
Conservative > aggressive: when in doubt, lower the delta.
The trend line shows cumulative change W1 → W4.
